node.statement: Let gbar be the graph family referred to in lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization for the fixed algebra and delta. The graph maps supplied there take values in B^{calH}_{2delta}(0) and solve f_U(A^par + gbar_U(A^par)) = 0. The target hypothesis says that, for every U and A^par, g_U(A^par) is the unique element of that same ball solving that same displayed equation; therefore g_U(A^par) = gbar_U(A^par) pointwise.
